subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain unmentioned group media for later mentioned turns, and if so under what opt-in, allowlist, TTL, and prompt-exposure limits?
rationale: The requested behavior fixes real lost context, but it directly intersects an intentional no-download default for unmentioned group media and would expose media that was not addressed to the bot.

options.title: Bounded opt-in retention
options.body: Preserve unmentioned group media only behind an explicit maintainer-approved group/topic policy or equivalent allowlisted boundary, with TTL cleanup, no path leakage in prompt text, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Default retention
options.body: Make recent unmentioned group media available by default, accepting the privacy and media-fetch behavior change as a product decision.

options.title: Keep no-download default
options.body: Leave media unavailable from unmentioned group history and close or document the behavior as a deliberate privacy/no-spam tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Bounded opt-in retention
recommendation.body: Preserve unmentioned group media only behind an explicit maintainer-approved group/topic policy or equivalent allowlisted boundary, with TTL cleanup, no path leakage in prompt text, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision must account for the no-download behavior introduced in the related Telegram fix that joshavant authored and merged.
